1417-4279-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6723-7297.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1432-5724.easyPrerequisites: Sage of the Maze and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Sage of the Maze, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6289-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6289-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6289-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1887-2021-2060-6260.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1987-2556-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2556-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-2556-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2741-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-7356-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

104-261-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-5147-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1912-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {3}{U} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1912-4682-7132.notes: If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.

3755-4028-4222.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

4321-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Food and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-2292-6972--112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
911-2292-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1170-1329-1537-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Conscripts.
When Zealous Conscripts enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2821-3542-4183.easyPrerequisites: You control up to six lands excluding Minamo that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{R}.
2821-3542-4183.description:
Activate up to six lands except Minamo by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.

2211-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2211-4508-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Captain's Hook, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4593-6705-6720.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6705-6720.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4871-5544-6011-6797.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
4871-5544-6011-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

112-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
112-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Clockspinning spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.
112-4613-5643-6586.notes: The mana cost assumes you've had only one Zombie enter the battlefield this turn. If you've had two or more, the cost becomes {3}{U} instead.

225-1170-2733-5954-6751.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-2733-5954-6751.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-3562-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar
2440-3562-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the token Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sky Hussar for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1429-4050-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4050-4452-5402.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

914-5140-5686.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5140-5686.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.
914-5140-5686.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2438-4336-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

777-1170-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

2608-4499-4667.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
2608-4499-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.

2590-4050-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2590-4050-5776.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow

2060-3525-5622.notablePrerequisites: Shaile does not have summoning sickness.
2060-3525-5622.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}.
Activate Shaile by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and any other creature that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Shaile.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-1692-2740-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Academy Manufactor.
You control at least five additional artifacts.
1558-1692-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor with haste.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

313-527-1500.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
313-527-1500.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{G}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {2}{B} due to Blood Funnel.
Blood Funnel triggers, causing you to sacrifice Selvala.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control another creature with power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

1308-3340-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
1308-3340-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

2773-2906-2931-5256.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
2773-2906-2931-5256.description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

539-618-1741.description:
Activate any mana-producing land you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries with haste.
The token Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, untapping the land and Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

417-992.description:
Gravity Sphere causes all creatures to lose flying.
Moat prevents non-flying creatures from attacking, and since no creatures can have flying, no creatures can attack.

1636-3402-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Predatory Urge attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3402-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Predatory Urge ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
